nodes.desc: make panels: runs the schematic builders and guards in order (hands to CATS: head-plan and panel-items steps and the sml-current guard included), skipping a step whose stamped inputs are unchanged (FULL=1 runs all).

nodes.label: run_panelpro_smoke_test.sh
nodes.desc: make panelpro-test: loads tables.xml in real PanelPro on the Mac, checks the core beans and quits; SKIPPED when PanelPro or CATS is open.

nodes.label: redeploy_commit.sh
nodes.desc: make redeploy (rollback): runs an older commit's own sync_hart_package.sh from a temporary worktree, with the deploy's guards.

nodes.label: live_paths.py
nodes.desc: Checks every path in live_paths.txt exists (deploy gate) and reports which commits touch a shipped path (deploy-status).

nodes.label: install_ops_files.sh
nodes.desc: Installs the six Operations Pro files into a host's JMRI operations folder, keeping a backup; guards an unpulled session.

nodes.label: install_jmri_web_override.sh
nodes.desc: Installs the JMRI web home page (STS and mimic links) into the profile's web folder on each host.

nodes.label: JMRI web home (Home.html)
nodes.desc: Hand-written JMRI web server home page with the STS and mimic links; hosts get it from the deploy.

nodes.label: patch_jmri_startup.py
nodes.desc: Adds or removes a Start Up script entry in a JMRI profile, used by the deploy to register the shipped jython.

nodes.label: agent_docs_map.py
nodes.desc: Draws the agent-doc lane of this map from the files: a box per agent doc and the links between them, in reading order from AGENTS.md; build_pipeline_map.py runs it and its --check fails when the graph differs.

nodes.label: map_lane.py
nodes.desc: The map's manifest lane: a box for each check.sh step's script, its inputs and outputs and its link to check.sh, from the step manifest (gen: manifest); build_pipeline_map.py draws it after the agent-doc lane.

nodes.label: build_pipeline_map.py
nodes.desc: Checks pipeline_map.json is current and that both map pages build; --check writes nothing. The pages are built, not committed (ADR-036): make map locally, the site build for the website.

nodes.label: merge_pipeline_map.py
nodes.desc: git merge driver for pipeline_map.json (by node id and edge ends); set by make wt and the session-start hook.

nodes.label: pipeline_map.js
nodes.desc: Layout and viewer script inlined into both pipeline map pages.

nodes.label: pipeline_map.json
nodes.desc: This map: domains, nodes and edges of every source, generator and output; hand-kept, checked against the repo.

nodes.label: docs/pipeline-map/index.html
nodes.desc: The repo copy of the pipeline map page; not committed (ADR-036): make map builds it, check.sh and CI build it in memory (--check).

nodes.label: library/pipeline-map.html
nodes.desc: Local copy of the website's pipeline map, for the site preview; not committed (ADR-036): make map builds it, and the website build writes its own copy (site_page()).

nodes.label: pipeline_query.py
nodes.desc: Prints what writes or reads a file, from pipeline_map.json, for agents and people.

nodes.label: pipeline_map_coverage.py
nodes.desc: check.sh pipeline-map-coverage: fails when a script the Makefile, make panels or a deploy runs, or a file in an output folder or an agent doc, is not in pipeline_map.json (check.sh's checks are boxes by construction: the manifest lane).

nodes.label: checks.toml
nodes.desc: The step manifest (ADR-037): one [[step]] per check.sh read-only check, with its command, lane and the files it reads and writes. check.sh and docs_checks.sh run their checks from it (ADR-037).

nodes.label: panels.toml
nodes.desc: The panels manifest (ADR-037 stage 5): one [[step]] per make panels step or guard, in run order, with its command, check_args, outputs (the stamps') and the files it reads; build_panels.sh runs them, panel_stamps.py takes the outputs, and the map draws each step's box from it.

nodes.label: manifest.py
nodes.desc: Loads and checks the step manifest against git and the map (names, commands, paths, lanes); prints each runner's job lines (jobs) and the steps (list); check.sh and docs_checks.sh run those lines, and the job stamps key on each job's entry and git refs (job_keys); every step is a job of its own.

nodes.label: speedmatch scripts
nodes.desc: Speed-match analysis (analyze.py, liverule.py), the Mac dashboard and the Pi live publisher (dashboard/publish_live.py with dashstate, dashsources); the deploy stages the publisher and its page for the Pi.

nodes.label: devices_generated.csv
nodes.desc: Device master, all three levels, the builders' file: every turnout, sensor, block, head, mast with public name, JMRI/system names, wiring, DCC address. Written only by build_device_map and panel_items; hartlib.devices merges it with devices_field.csv into the one view readers get.

nodes.label: devices_field.csv
nodes.desc: The device master's owner's cells, keyed by level and device id: staging's devices (names, layout blocks, comments, DCC, control points) and a Store's level-less devices. Written by hand and by split_store.py; read by the builders.

nodes.label: media/schematic-evolution
nodes.desc: Folder of schematic frames and the evolution GIF in the main checkout's gitignored media/ (a worktree links it).

nodes.label: media/pulled-stores
nodes.desc: Pulled PanelPro Store files with .base, in the main checkout's gitignored media/ (HART_PULLED_DIR moves it); input to split_store.py.

nodes.label: film_pace.py
nodes.desc: The pace shared by the four panel films on behind/panel-evolution.html: 0.4 s a version, the last held 2 s (#858).

nodes.label: panel-evolution films
nodes.desc: The four panel films and posters (schematic, CATS, LE, USS) shown on behind/panel-evolution.html; the schematic pair is written by evolution.py --site.

nodes.label: template_edit.py
nodes.desc: One-line edits of what PanelPro owns (memories, clock, manager settings) in tables_template.xml, then rebuilds tables.xml with build_tables.py and checks it; the template and tables.xml are put back on failure (#862).

nodes.label: <main checkout>/.cache/hart/schematic
nodes.desc: The schematic plugin's solved-sheet cache, shared by every worktree (SCHEMATIC_CACHE; check.sh sets it too); a run after a small change redoes only what that change reaches.

nodes.label: .cache/panel-stamps (per checkout)
nodes.desc: make panels step stamps (panel_stamps.py): a step whose inputs, code, plugin commit and outputs match its last good run is skipped; FULL=1 ignores them.

nodes.label: <main checkout>/.cache/hart/check-stamps
nodes.desc: tools/check.sh job stamps (check_stamps.py): content hashes of a job's declared inputs; a job whose inputs match its last pass is skipped (not in CI, not with FULL=1) (#880).

nodes.label: discovered_sml.stamp
nodes.desc: Digest of the discovery base that run_sml_discover.sh used; the sml-current guard compares it with the base the sources give now.

nodes.label: plan_generated.json
nodes.desc: The generated half of plan_overrides: staging control points and stations, name_main and milepost_route, main_upper main_route, control_points and stations. Each of three builders replaces only its own keys (T6b).

nodes.label: preferences_generated.json
nodes.desc: The generated half of preferences: staging's detail_sheets, from sheets.csv. hartlib.layer_files merges it under preferences.json (hand values win).

nodes.label: panel_window_sizes.py
nodes.desc: Sets each Layout Editor panel window size a JMRI profile remembers (user-interface.xml) to the size tables.xml gives it; run by hand with JMRI closed, not part of make panels or a deploy.

nodes.label: pi_panel_window_sizes.sh
nodes.desc: Runs panel_window_sizes.py on the Pi's profile: checks first, quits PanelPro, sets the sizes, keeps a backup and starts PanelPro again.

nodes.label: pi-os image build
nodes.desc: Builds the layout Pi's 64-bit trixie SD card image on the Mac (sdm pluglist, Lima VM); the image holds secrets and never leaves the Mac.

nodes.label: operating.sh
nodes.desc: Sets, clears and prints the operating flag (~/.hart_operating, ADR-025); its guard subcommand stops a layout deploy to the Pi or Windows while the flag is set (HART_DEPLOY_WHILE_OPERATING=1 overrides).

nodes.label: move_path.py
nodes.desc: Moves or renames a tracked file or folder (git mv) and rewrites every repo-root path, relative link and a moved script's repo-root depth that names it; lists name-only mentions to check by hand; rebuilds the docs index and map pages.

nodes.label: hart-mqtt-race-fix.jar
nodes.desc: JMRI 5.16's MqttAdapter with the JMRI/JMRI#16004 race fix, one class, built by build.sh (ADR-034).

nodes.label: install_overlay.py
nodes.desc: Puts the MQTT race overlay in a host's jmri.conf (--cp:p), only over the JMRI build it was made from (ADR-034).

nodes.label: hartlib hand_lists.py
nodes.desc: The one reader of the owner's hand lists: block_overrides.csv, main_lines.csv (stops by block ID, named from the name store), mast_cells.csv and the USS board grid; each stops naming the file and line.

nodes.label: hartlib drawing_keys.py
nodes.desc: The one reader of the device master's drawing keys (trial_name) for every level: each schematic piece's device by ID, named from the merged view (naming-layers step 13).

nodes.label: check_data_readers
nodes.desc: Audit: no script outside hartlib names a layout data file (jmri/layouts/hart/data/) but the pairs it allows, each with its reason; Jython inside JMRI reads only generated outputs.

nodes.label: check_wiring_frozen.py
nodes.desc: Audits wiring.csv against the form the wiring freeze left it in; writes nothing.

nodes.label: hartlib railroad.py
nodes.desc: The fact files against each other (the device master, switches.csv, masts.csv, the tables file); KNOWN in hartlib.railroad lists what is reported and left.

nodes.label: check_py_sizes
nodes.desc: Fails when a Python file over 800 lines grows past its row in tools/audit/py_sizes.csv; --update tightens the list, --accept raises a row by name.

nodes.label: backup_launchagents.sh (make backup-status)
nodes.desc: Installs and checks the Mac LaunchAgents that run the daily Pi pull and the weekly Windows push (ADR-035).

nodes.label: backup_pi_pull.sh
nodes.desc: Daily: snapshots the Pi's ~/.jmri, JMRI user files, ~/speedmatch, ~/Desktop, ~/.java, app launchers and ~/jmrihelp into ~/Backups/hart/pi on the Mac, then runs the STS pull (ADR-035).

nodes.label: backup_win_push.sh
nodes.desc: Weekly: mirrors the Mac's gitignored data, the Pi snapshots and the AnyRail plans into WSL on the Windows box (ADR-035).

nodes.label: agent: archive-researcher
nodes.desc: Researches railroad and local history and curates archive material for the site: photos, web sources, plant history. Returns proposals with sources; it does not change data files.

nodes.label: agent: finding-verifier
nodes.desc: Read-only check of one claimed bug against the code. Use to triage a single /code-review or audit finding. It answers CONFIRMED, PLAUSIBLE or WRONG with the file and line that show it.

nodes.label: agent: panel-tracer
nodes.desc: Read-only diagnosis of JMRI, CATS, SML and MQTT behaviour on the HART layout. Use for questions like why a mast stays red, why a CATS desk shows a block wrong, or where a device name or value comes from.

nodes.label: agent: repo-auditor
nodes.desc: Read-only audit of repository health: dead code, stale docs and wiki pages, structure and duplication. Use for periodic reviews, not for reviewing a diff.

nodes.label: agent: schematic-builder
nodes.desc: Edits the schematic and panel build code under tools/schematic/, tools/hartlib/ and the Layout Editor scripts. Use for schematic, Layout Editor, panel and device-map changes. Give it one bounded job; it always runs in a worktree.

nodes.label: agent: site-builder
nodes.desc: Builds and changes pages and data in the public website under www/. Use for portal pages, rebuilds and content changes. Give it one bounded job; split large rebuilds into stages.

nodes.label: agent: site-reviewer
nodes.desc: Read-only review of the public website through a lens named in the brief: UX, first-time reader, historian, designer, writer or security. Use for audits of www/ and hartrailroad.com.

nodes.label: agent: voice-reviewer
nodes.desc: Read-only review of any text (docs, wiki, site pages, slides, commit and PR text, deck cards) against the writing rules. Returns findings with suggested rewrites; it does not edit.

nodes.label: /done
nodes.desc: Run the HART close-out (wiki, commit, push, deploy, report)

nodes.label: skill: deploy
nodes.desc: Use when live artifacts changed and need to reach the layout hosts (Pi, Windows) or the public website, when asked to run sync_hart_package.sh or deploy_hartrailroad.sh, or when a deploy fails with a connection error, a missing media check or a Build count drop.

nodes.label: skill: handoff
nodes.desc: Use when the owner says go on a hand-off or a plan with several independent items, when a job is split across parallel subagents, or when briefing, tracking, merging or closing out several agents' work.

nodes.label: skill: operating-flag
nodes.desc: Use when the owner says they are operating or done operating, when a speed-matching job is dropped on the layout or its run ends, when a hook blocks a Pi or Windows action because the operating flag is set, or when asked to run tools/hosts/operating.sh.

nodes.label: skill: ops-pull
nodes.desc: Use when a Pi Operations Pro session (moves, car or train state) must be saved into the repo, before any deploy that would replace the Pi's Operations files, or when asked to run make ops-pull.

nodes.label: skill: panel-approval
nodes.desc: Use before asking the owner to approve a panel, CATS desk, schematic or other drawing, or a published look; when a panel, desk or drawing change is ready for the owner to look at; when an approval fingerprint (check_approved.py, approved_*.sha256) changed; or before publishing a new look on the site.

nodes.label: skill: panelpro
nodes.desc: Use when PanelPro must be quit or started on the Mac (after a Store is pulled, or before asking the owner to approve a panel) or on the Pi (around a deploy or make ops-pull), or when asked to run pi_quit_panelpro.sh or pi_start_panelpro.sh.

nodes.label: skill: sts-live
nodes.desc: Use when an STS change (sts-docker or sts-plugins code, a workflow, or data such as shipments, locations, cars or waybills) must reach the live STS on the Pi, when asked to run pi_sts_update.sh or make sts-pull, when the Mac STS (UAT) must be refreshed from the Pi, or when a job needs the live STS API.

nodes.label: skill: tables-pull
nodes.desc: Use when a PanelPro Store on the Pi or the Mac has changed JMRI_UserFiles/tables.xml and it must come back into the repo, when deploy stops with "tables.xml changed since the last deploy" or "the Pi's tables.xml changed", or before committing after a PanelPro session.

nodes.label: skill: whats-left
nodes.desc: Use when asked what is left, pending, next, or for a to-do or loose-ends list, and at the end of a hand-off.

nodes.label: .cursor/ (Cursor mirrors)
nodes.desc: Cursor's copies of the Claude rules: commands, the close-out rule and the main-branch guard.

nodes.desc: Agent instructions for this folder.
